diagram_math_checks.objects_and_maps: D is an arbitrary basis matching in TL_2(C,delta). The box has two top and two bottom ports. iota_2:TL_2 -> TL_3 appends strand 3 on the right; c_2:TL_3 -> TL_2 closes its top and bottom endpoints. E_2=delta^-1 c_2. Domains/codomains follow the local tower definition.
relations_checked: Left panel: strand 3 and the dashed exterior arc join the same top/bottom endpoints, forming exactly one closed cycle disjoint from D. The original two D ports remain unchanged; therefore c_2(iota_2(D))=delta D and E_2(iota_2(D))=D.

Right panel: iota_2(D) is above d_2, in accordance with xy=x circle y and the left-factor-above convention. The d_2 cap joins interface points 2,3, its cup joins exterior bottom points 2,3, and point 1 passes straight through.

Right panel endpoint traversal: bottom port 2 of D -> cap -> appended strand 3 -> exterior dashed closure -> cup -> exterior bottom point 2. This is a single path, not a cycle; top points 1,2 and the first bottom path are preserved. Hence the induced matching is D with no extra circle, giving c_2(iota_2(D)d_2)=D and E_2(iota_2(D)d_2)=delta^-1 D.

Both panels have noncrossing solid strands; closure is outside the retained strands. The same last-two-strand traversal leaves all first n-1 connections unchanged for general n. No trace or positivity relation is asserted by the drawing.
